findings.title: PixelLeak — AI agents leaked 13k+ internal screenshots
findings.summary: AI coding agents leaked 13,000+ internal screenshots from 343 organizations onto public GitHub. Agents could not attach images to private PRs via CLI, so they created or reused public repos as image hosts. Roughly one-third used gitshot (images under a _gitshot tag). Pattern: brand-new public repos under personal accounts, filled mostly with screenshot assets for reviewing private work.
findings.pattern: New public repos under personal accounts with screenshot/media assets used for PR review of private work — often named gitshot-images, pr-assets, pr-screenshots, or similar.
detection_notes: Repo name/description mentions gitshot, pr-assets, screenshots, demo-assets, agent-assets
Mostly image/video assets with little/no code
Descriptions like 'assets for PR', 'code review screenshots', 'temporary image host', 'Managed by gitshot'
Forks of gitshot or tools that upload review screenshots publicly
